newsitem.title: USA: ShopKo fiscal year sales top $2.0 billion.
newsitem.headline: ShopKo fiscal year sales top $2.0 billion.

text.p: ShopKo Stores Inc said its sales for the fiscal year ended February 22 surpassed $2.0 billion.

Dale Kramer, ShopKo president, said he credited the company's "Vision 2000" merchandising strategy that focuses on quality merchandise and service. Launched in 1991, nearly all ShopKo stores now reflect the upscale Vision 2000 strategy.
Kramer also cited the growth of ProVantage, ShopKo's health services subsidiary providing managed care products and services, as important to achieving the $2 billion milestone.
"ProVantage continues to be a key competitive advantage and a significant opportunity for growth," Kramer said.
ShopKo is a leading regional retailer operating 130 stores in 15 states.
